Record ideas, observations and insights relevant to intentions as work progresses

questions.q: A student only draws from one internet photograph. Which AO1 element is weak?

questions.q: What is a blind contour drawing and what does it train?
questions.model: Drawing the edges of an object while looking at it and not at the paper. It trains close observation and line quality.
